finalText: Migration complete and verified. All 12 stragglers (`analytics`, `orders`, `billing`, `support`, `catalog`, `accounts` packages) now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`; the vendored `legacy-orm/adapter.js` was left untouched since it's overwritten on every upgrade, and `cache.query` calls were correctly left alone as unrelated. `verify.js` confirms a clean pass.
